FSPLIT.justification: Splits the problem into three branches: Density_Conditions (d*(A)>0), Combinatorial_Gaps (lacunary), Furstenberg_Correspondence (ergodic lifting)

FFUSE.justification: Reunites the branches into the final result: d*(A)>0 sufficient but not necessary; piecewise syndetic and Bohr sets complete the picture

EVALT.justification: Constructive proof that d*(A) > 0 implies syndetic D(A) via Furstenberg correspondence

EVALF.justification: Constructive refutation: A = {2ⁿ} has finite D(A) = {0}, unbounded gaps, zero density

ENGAGR.justification: Holds both syndetic D(A) and d*(A)=0 simultaneously — piecewise syndetic sets and Bohr set containment without resolution

IFIX.justification: Permanent append-only fixation of each proven result: Furstenberg 1981, lacunary bounds, thick/syndetic duality, Bohr characterization
